author: Clickn
body:
Hello there fellow mineman. I assume most of ya guys have forge or Magic Launcher to run mods that will help you with pvp and others, but there are some unfortunate fellows that do not trust many mods as they could have trojans and viruses, So i compiled a pvp mod pack that players could use and can add more if they wish. I will give some edges about this pack and hopefully peeps can send it to others.
Here are some things that it includes
https://www.mediafire.com/folder/jd6mt4e4p8bxv/Mods_that_are_100%25_safe <------------DOWNLOAD

For starters, there will be 2 forge installers, for 1.7 and for 1.8, Click them and from there, Install forge as it will give you a prompt. 
Now to the juicy details.

1.7
This will include of 12 mods. 
Some of these mods include Optifine,Armor/StatusHUD,Batty's Coords,Schematica(DEFAULT),ToggleSneak,etc            
Full list here--->http://imgur.com/a/c0CF7

1.8 
Kinda the same thing but with less things
Full List <------------------------http://imgur.com/a/SeykC

This is just a preview as i cant fit every single detail , Just download the pack and see for your self :D
